about: TEMPLATE for SUBJECTIVE impressions (how a session felt). Each note must say who, when and in what context, and be marked kind=subjective. Numbers you measured belong in a bundle, not here.

example.author: your name
example.selection: provider/model, or null for the whole run
example.context: how you observed it, e.g. 20 minutes of play on desktop, live director
example.text: e.g. rooms felt samey after the first ten
